    LEGAL & SUPPORT

    Terms, refunds & FAQs

    Last updated: 25 September 2026

    This is a plain summary of how Forever Careers works, not formal legal advice. If you need a fully compliant policy for your specific circumstances, it's worth having a solicitor review it.

    1. Who we are

    Forever Careers ("we", "us") is a UK based career support service covering remote, hybrid and in person roles, operating at forevercalculatedcareers.com. You can reach us at forevercalculated@gmail.com.

    2. Our services

    Browsing live roles and using the free CV checker is free and does not require an account. Creating a free account unlocks full access to apply for live roles. We also offer a separate CV Optimisation service, and we link to third party courses which may pay us a commission if you enrol.

    3. Payments & pricing

    Prices are shown in your local currency where available and are processed securely through Stripe. We do not store your card details. Prices may change from time to time; any change will not affect a payment you've already made.

    4. Free account

    Your Forever Careers account is free. There is no subscription and no card is needed to browse or apply for roles. You can ask us to delete your account at any time.

    5. Refund policy

    Once a payment has been made, it is final and non-refundable. This applies to CV Optimisation, career services, CV Snake games and any other paid service. By purchasing, you confirm you'd like your service to begin straight away and understand this means you give up the standard 14 day cancellation right under UK consumer law once the service has started.

    6. CV Optimisation delivery

    We aim to deliver your tailored CV or CVs within 24 hours of your order being confirmed. Delivery times can occasionally vary. As above, this service is non-refundable once your order has been placed and work has begun.

    7. Acceptable use

    We treat every client with respect, and we expect the same in return. We do not tolerate abuse, harassment or disrespect toward our team in any form. We reserve the right to suspend or permanently revoke access to our services, without refund, for anyone who breaches this.

    8. No guarantee of employment

    We provide career support, CV help and access to live roles. We do not guarantee that you'll be offered an interview or a job. Outcomes depend on many factors outside our control.

    9. Changes to these terms

    We may update these terms from time to time. The current version will always be available on this page.

    11. Your data and privacy

    When you create an account we store your email address, when you joined and when you last visited. When you tap Apply on a role while signed in, we record the role and the time so we can show you your application history and improve our service. If you tick the box to save your CV in the free CV checker, we store the CV text and your score in your account so we can help with your search. We never sell your data. You can ask us to see or delete your data at any time by emailing forevercalculated@gmail.com.

    10. Governing law

    These terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales.

    Is browsing roles really free?

    Yes. Browsing, the free CV checker and applying for roles are all free. You only need a free account to open the apply links.

    Do I have to pay to apply for jobs?

    No. Applying for every role on Forever Careers is free with an account. We only charge for optional extras like CV Optimisation.

    Do you offer refunds?

    No. All payments, including CV Optimisation, are final once made. Please see our refund policy above for the full details.

    How long does CV Optimisation take?

    We aim to deliver your tailored CV or CVs within 24 hours of your order being confirmed.

    Which countries do you cover?

    We list live roles across 19 countries, including the UK, US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa, India and much of Europe and Latin America. Some roles can only be opened by people located in that country.

    What if I need visa sponsorship?

    Let us know in the job readiness questionnaire. We'll take this into account when an agent contacts you.

    How does the free CV checker work?

    It matches keywords in your CV against today's live roles. It's a helpful starting point, not an AI verdict or a guarantee of a match.

    What happens if I'm abusive to your team?

    We do not tolerate abuse or disrespect toward our team. Access to our services may be suspended or permanently revoked without refund.

    How do I contact you?

    Email forevercalculated@gmail.com, or message us on Instagram or TikTok @forevercalculatedcareers.
